constraints.name: admin_notification_reads_admin_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (admin_user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: coupons_free_gift_configuration_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reward_type <> 'free_gift'::text) OR ((gift_product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (minimum_order_amount > (0)::numeric) AND (discount_value = (0)::numeric))))

constraints.name: coupons_gift_product_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (gift_product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: coupons_valid_date_range_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((starts_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at > starts_at)))

constraints.name: orders_checkout_owner_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((num_nonnulls(user_id, guest_token_hash, customer_identity_id) = 1) AND ((guest_token_hash IS NULL) OR (guest_token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraints.name: orders_customer_identity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (customer_identity_id) REFERENCES customer_identities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: orders_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: site_settings_default_gst_slab_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (default_gst_slab_id) REFERENCES catalog_gst_slabs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

triggers.event: CREATE TRIGGER trg_coupons_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.coupons FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER orders_record_status_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_order_status_history()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_orders_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_restore_order_stock_on_cancel AFTER UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION restore_order_stock_on_cancel()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_site_settings_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.site_settings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
